implemented: Added a platform-neutral uninstall cleanup contract with explicit App cache, Stored credentials and Recovery history choices; every option is unchecked by default and declares vaultDisposition=preserve.
Added a visible Settings handoff that lets a user select local app-data categories and reports the selected categories without accessing the vault or dispatching deletion.
Exported the runtime contract through the shared UI barrel, documented the desktop/Expo reuse boundary and covered the contract with a portable test and static layout marker.
limitations: No operating-system uninstall hook or deletion action is implemented; a host must perform any local app-data cleanup only after separate explicit confirmation.
Vault bytes, unresolved conflicts and source notes remain outside this cleanup contract and are not deleted.
Actual OS encryption readback, long-running retention validation, visible Electron automation, cross-platform interaction and reference Obsidian reopen checks remain pending.
